physicalNotes: Radius 11.028 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114971: radius 11.028 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 62.783 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.052) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 7,672,180 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 4896 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 114971: effective temperature 4896 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.04) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
